tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and player background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: bg-side
tokens.usage: Sidebar, bottom tab bar and the slightly sunken ground behind the mini player.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: selection toolbar, ask row, describe strip, toast, mini player.

tokens.name: bg-raise
tokens.usage: Hover and active fill for nav items, icon buttons and toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and around sections.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of chips, outline buttons, floating panels and inputs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, icons, the play ring and primary button fill. Softened white: never use pure #fff.

tokens.name: ink-sub
tokens.usage: Secondary text: artist names, descriptions, inactive nav, unselected chip text. 7.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ink-mute
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, timestamps, meta lines, section notes. 5.2:1 on bg. Smallest text colour allowed.

tokens.name: wave-off
tokens.usage: Unplayed waveform bars and empty meter bars. Graphic only, never text.

tokens.name: wave-played
tokens.usage: Waveform bars before the playhead.

tokens.name: playhead
tokens.usage: The 1px playhead line across the waveform.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The only accent. Means 'a moment you chose': selected waveform bars, saved-moment dots, the selected trait, confirmations. Never decorative.

tokens.name: accent-saved
tokens.usage: Waveform bars inside an already saved moment.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the selection band behind selected waveform bars.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of the selection band; underline under tappable phrases in the DNA portrait.

tokens.name: chip-on
tokens.usage: Fill of a pressed chip or selected tab. Selection is shown with a soft fill, never solid white.

tokens.name: chip-on-line
tokens.usage: Border of a pressed chip or selected tab.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink-filled primary button.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The one big number in the centre of the DNA ring.

styles.name: portrait
styles.sample: You light up when a voice lifts over the music.
styles.usage: The plain-language DNA sentence. Centred, max 760px wide.

styles.name: track-title
styles.usage: Song title on the player. 22px on phones.

styles.name: item
styles.usage: List row titles: traits, moments, songs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, buttons, captions under rows, guide lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row labels in strips, pills, analysis notes. Never smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between chips in a row; icon to label inside small buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group; strip row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon to text in rows; gap between chips and their label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between columns in a row; transport button spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the track header and the waveform.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Breathing room above the ring and below the portrait.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Waveform bars and ring ticks (2px wide).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Square chips ('what you love'), toolbar buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Floating panels: selection toolbar, ask row, describe strip, toast.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The rare grouped surface; phone mini player.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Round chips ('how it feels'), tabs, buttons, the play ring.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Only on the floating selection toolbar and the toast. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar. Below 820px it becomes a bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the centred content column on every page.

tokens.name: breakpoint-tabs
tokens.usage: Below this width: sidebar hides, bottom tabs appear.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: Below this width: volume hides, list rows drop secondary columns.

tokens.name: wave-bar
tokens.usage: Width of one waveform bar; bars are spaced 5px centre to centre.

tokens.name: hit-target
tokens.usage: Minimum size of every tappable control.
